    Reference catalogue¶

    This catalogue merges the reference lists of all 200 library sources: 1506 distinct documents, cited 2920 times in total. 84 of them are in our library; the rest are cited but not publicly available as far as we know (for example ESA-internal SUMs, ADDs and ICDs). Entries are merged by normalised document identifier, or by title when there is no identifier, so variant spellings may still appear separately.

    Looking for an internal document?

    Many SCOS-2000 documents are distributed only with the software (MICONYS, under the ESA Software Community License). The catalogue tells you their exact identifiers and which public documents cite them.

    About this information

    Everything here comes from public sources

    All information on this site was retrieved from sources that are publicly available online. They include CCSDS and ECSS standards, ESA/ESOC documents, conference papers, and a Solar Orbiter MIB release posted by an instrument team. Every page cites the documents it relies on.

    The Sources & copies page lists each document with a link back to its original location and the date and time we copied it.

    This is an independent, community wiki. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by ESA, CCSDS, ECSS or any mission team. Third-party documents remain the property of their owners.
